method.transport: same OfflineSimulator.post monkeypatched into each real main; no proxy controller
method.source_sampling: N random in [10,16], r=1800*sqrt(U), distinct channels, Ri uniform in [1000,1500]
method.direction_error: deterministic hash(seed, channel/source, round(position,2)) in [-1,1], rounded to two decimals; fixed modes used only in fixed/adversarial cases
method.timing: accepted measure=move/5+channel switch+5s; accepted clear failure=move/5+3s; accepted clear success=move/5+5s; clear does not switch channel
method.stats: discovery/clear are source-level; per-source time is clear completion minus first accepted discovery completion; successful-game totals are separately summarized
method.outside_ablation: paired same source/error scenario and same per-state unrestricted candidate generator; target-only filters candidate norm > 1800
method.limits: all sources are omnidirectional in this offline harness; no directional coverage cone is injected
method.fixed_experiment_refresh: Experiment 6 uses controlled pre-observed slender regions and production-default active process_channel; Experiment 7 counts only planner-selected outside points as active outside use.
